browserSuite.note: Full regression suite passed with the shared-layout invalidation fix. The final build then narrowed coupon query fields and removed unused imports; its affected cases were rerun below.

typescript: passed, including the final Docker production build
checks: Carousel edited and reordered in the admin UI; image-only home with previous/next controls
Collection previews capped at six actual products; category with one product shows one
